GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Checked from heels when the pace of the race eased near the 1400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down last 11 Lengths from the lead, made no ground to Turn then Held Up 400m-300m, hooked Wide Straightening Up and Made Good Ground down the outside in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re tactics adopted (riding from 800m). Jockey stated it was travelling well middle stages and, being rearward on a tight track, he felt it best to ride for luck. When questioned re his riding near 500m he explained his mindset was still to ride for luck and, becoming aware he wouldn't find clear running, shifted wider whereby it let down strongly and finished the race off well. Comments noted.] # ran on well late
